name: Grand Temple
description: Colonnaded nave, a high altar and light falling from clerestory windows.
palette: pale marble, gold leaf, deep votive blue, censer smoke grey
lighting: broad shafts of coloured light from high windows, candlelight at the altar
aesthetics: Hand-painted fantasy cartography, rough painterly brushwork with visible strokes, strong dark ink outlines around every object and wall, subtle black and brown linework, restrained desaturated colour, flat orthographic projection with every object drawn as its top surface and a short soft shadow cast beside it on the floor, inked line art over watercolour and gouache, premium hand-drawn D&D virtual tabletop map, dense environmental storytelling
ground: polished marble floor laid in pale slabs with a darker inlaid border, worn faintly smooth down the middle where feet have passed
materials: A grand fantasy temple seen from above with everything above it taken away. A long nave of polished marble flagstones with two rows of fluted stone columns down either side of it, rows of timber pews facing a raised sanctuary, a heavy carved stone altar on a stepped plinth, standing candelabra and bronze censers trailing smoke, coloured light from tall clerestory windows falling in broad shafts across the floor, a chapter room with shelves of ledgers, a stone basin of still water, gilded ornament worked into the capitals and the altar front.
